clauses.title: Return window
clauses.body: Items may be returned up to and including day 30 after delivery. The day of delivery is day 0.

clauses.title: Damaged or defective items
clauses.body: Items that arrive damaged, or that have a manufacturing defect, are eligible for a full refund, including original shipping.

clauses.title: Normal wear and tear
clauses.body: Normal wear and tear from use (for example scuffs, creasing, sole wear, pilling, or fading) is not a defect and is not eligible for a refund under P2.

clauses.title: Photo evidence
clauses.body: A photo of the item is required for any return claiming damage, a defect, a wrong item, or an item not as described.

clauses.title: Change of mind
clauses.body: Change-of-mind returns must be unused and in their original packaging. A return shipping fee of $6.95 is deducted from the refund.

clauses.title: Final Sale items
clauses.body: Items marked Final Sale cannot be returned, unless they arrived damaged, defective, or were the wrong item.

clauses.title: High-value refunds
clauses.body: Any refund above $250 requires approval by a returns manager before it is issued.

clauses.title: Wrong item or not as described
clauses.body: If we sent the wrong item, or the item is materially different from its product description, the customer receives a full refund including original shipping.

clauses.title: Refund method and timing
clauses.body: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days of approval.
